FORMAT LAW. Honour the grammar of the wholesome animal narration — its native framing, its edit rhythm, and the specific thing audiences expect from it. If the format loops, the last frame must match the first.

CAMERA. Compose 9:16 with the action in the safe centre band. Use a slow push with a simultaneous barely-perceptible dutch roll on a 90mm tilt-shift, framing with rule-of-thirds weighting to frame-left with open air to the right.

OUTPUT. Your entire reply is the prompt itself: one dense paragraph, no title, no quotation marks, no trailing notes.
